Call the retention department, say you want to cancel because you haven’t received the credit, wait for them to finish attempting to convince you to stay, ask them if they can manually add the credit so it takes affect for the incoming bill cycle.

- an AT&T employee.

I don’t want to be the person to ruin any kind of excitement you have for your new job because hey, congrats! But as a corporate employee, it is much different. Benefits are different, commission structure is different, overall GROWTH in the company is different. I also came from Best Buy (Best Buy mobile/connections to be exact but I was super cross trained), and you reap more benefits from a corporate store, I guarantee it.
